rules.unchanged: Only byte-normalized equivalent English plus the same Chinese sense may carry mastery through an explicit equivalent mapping.
rules.movedLevel: An unchanged knowledge point may move level while retaining an explicit equivalent mapping; level movement itself does not create mastery.
rules.rewritten: Any changed answer or sense retires the v1 identity and creates a new v2 identity with zero mastery.
rules.removed: Retired identities remain resolvable for R13-D history but cannot be selected for new training.
rules.sceneIsolation: No daily identity maps to a scene identity, even when text matches.
rules.wrongAnswers: Active wrong answers retain their original frozen prompt and answer through the retirement record; they are never silently redirected to changed content.
rules.growth: Only exact-equivalent mappings may carry R17 evidence. Replacements start without evidence.

requiredArtifactsBeforeRelease: daily-level-identity-migration.v1.json containing one disposition for every released v1 identity
validator report with zero blocking violations
application-layer migration tests for R13-D and R17
